purpose: Close improvement 3's refs/tags/ arm, undrivable before a real upstream tag existed.
immutability_note: evidence/v2.1.0-release/ holds the product-commit captures (5e5150b). It was overwritten in error during this run and restored from HEAD. Captures are read-only per evidence/AGENTS.md:22; this is a separate run, not an edit.

commands.command: HOME=$(mktemp -d) bash tools/proofpunk-install.sh --target claude-code --source github --ref v2.1.0 --only proofpunk

tag_arm_assertions_from_raw_capture.skill_file_caveat: HOME was a temp-dir shell variable, unrecoverable after the run, so that check is not re-verifiable from disk. The INSTALL and summary lines are, and establish the same fact.

separate_homes: full-install and tag-install each ran under their own mktemp -d, so neither could collide with or observe the other.
compound_wrapper_note: The shell invocation producing the install captures exited 1 overall. That exit belongs to its final `grep -c SKIP`, which returns 1 on no matches — the desired result. It is not the installer's rc. Each installer rc was read from $? immediately after its own command, with no pipeline.
tag_placement: v2.1.0 points at the product commit, not this evidence commit. Moving a published tag is risky once consumers may have fetched it, so the tag stays and the closure evidence lands in the follow-up commit.
